stage1.impression: A glossy red top deck with a sculpted horn and a dark dome driver, shot close and high: the horn's inner reflections sell the gloss, but the big red planes and the white body are almost flat in value, and the white reads as dull grey. A thin dark line traces the horn's arch like a CG outline, and the crop cuts the back wall while leaving a wide, empty white band at the bottom, so it reads as a competent draft rather than a hero frame.

blocking_9: Brand colour: the lit roof within dE2000 2.5 of #C62828 (now 174/29/33, dE 5.47 over [960,280,1160,600], luminance 59.9 against 73.6 for the specified red), and the white front at a median of 226-236 (now part:front-baffle 204.2), with no clipping.

Framing: the whole gable top inside the frame with at least 50 px of background beside it. Now the fin's top edge is above the frame from x=214 to 950 and within 0-36 px of the top edge from 950 to 1290 (p5 49.2 in [200,0,1350,40]); the front-left eave corner sits about 52 px outside the left edge (hip and eave traced to (-52,634)); the back-right eave corner sits about 46 px outside the right edge (traced to (1396,422)).

The mouth's lower lip and the eave read as crisp, lit edges: a 1-3 px line at least 30 levels above the floor beside it. Now it is +9: at x=300 the floor is 64.7, the lip 74.0, the fascia 59.5; at x=600 they are 61.8, 72.2 and 55.3.

No dead-flat planes: the right gable end is 31.0 from top to bottom (profile 31.1 to 30.9 over [1240,380,1320,520], range 1.4), and the horn's right wall is 41.1-42.8 over 150 px at x=850. Each needs a graded reflection of at least 12 levels along its length.

The hips' 6 mm rounds read as radiused edges: the roof-to-gable-end hip is a 30 px ramp from 62.6 to 30.8 (row y=250) with no highlight. It needs a highlight line at least 20 levels above the roof beside it.

The throat reads as a formed surface: left of the tweeter it is a flat 26.9 (p5 20.1, p95 35.0 over [595,280,640,400]). It needs a gradient of at least 15 levels so the dome visibly sits at the bottom of a shaped throat.

The 3 mm shadow line under the gable reads as a dark line: at x=300 it is a 4 px pink-grey band (188/173/173 to 195/181/181, luminance about 176-184) under a bright line (215/204/204), only about 25 levels below the 206 white. It should sit at least 60 levels below the white beside it.

changes.problem: The frame is about 0.4 EV under for the product's specified colours: the lit roof renders 174/29/33 against #C62828, and the #FFFFFF front renders as a light grey.

evidence.measured: Roof right of the waveguide: rgb median 174/29/33, dE2000 5.47 against #C62828, luminance 59.9 (the specified red is 73.6). part:gable-block dE 5.37 (174/32/36). part:front-baffle median 204.2 (206/204/204, dE 11.08 against #FFFFFF). part:side-right 140.9. Whole frame: p99 210.2, maximum 222.3, clip 0.0%, so there is headroom.

changes.expected: These figures come from a +0.40 EV simulation that inverts the PBR Neutral tone map and checks a lossless round trip. part:front-baffle median about 231. Roof [960,280,1160,600] about 198/40/44, dE about 1.1. part:gable-block dE about 1.8 (198/44/48). Shaded white side about 162. Tweeter dome p95 about 144 (now 123.6). Frame p99 about 235, clip 0.0%.

changes.problem: The gable top almost fits the width but not quite: the front-left eave corner is cut off about 52 px past the left edge and the back-right eave corner about 46 px past the right edge, so both hips end in slivers at the frame edges instead of reading as a silhouette.

evidence.measured: Left 50 px column: p5 63.5, red roof running into the edge (first red pixel x=2 at y=520, x=0 from y=560). The left hip (x=209 at y=80 to x=2 at y=520) meets the eave line y=644+0.191x at about (-52,634). On the right, [1300,300,1350,500] is the gable end at 31.0 touching the edge; its back hip (1290,195)-(1339,300) meets the side's top edge (1338,500)-(1116,800) at about (1396,422). Product extent -52 to 1396, centred on x=672.

changes.expected: The camera position is unchanged, so perspective and reflections stay as they are; the image scales by 0.838 about its centre. The front-left eave corner moves to about x=66 and the back-right eave corner to about x=1279, leaving 66-71 px of background on each side. The waveguide narrows from 841 to about 705 px and the tweeter surround from 121 to about 101 px. The left column [0,250,50,700] turns to background (p5 about 150-170 after c1). At f/16 the back-right corner, about 180 mm behind focus, blurs by about 1.7 px.

changes.problem: The fin, a must-show for context, has its top edge cut off by the top of the frame from x=214 to 950, then riding 0-36 px under that edge to its end at x=1290, a near-tangent with a grey sliver above it.

evidence.measured: Top 40 rows: p5 49.2, median 63.3 (fin red). The fin is red in row 0 for x=250-950; its top edge enters at x about 960 and is at y=5 at x=1000, y=16 at x=1100 and y=32 at x=1250. Extrapolated, its left end (x=214) is at about y=-82, 82 px above the frame.

changes.expected: This tilts the camera up 1.04 degrees (0.026 m at 1.33 m, cos 21.4 deg), about 60 px at 88 mm. With c2, the fin's whole top edge comes into frame, from about y=64 at its left end (x about 289) to about y=163 at its right end (x about 1190), with background above it. The insert's lowest point stays at about y=818, 82 px above the bottom. The tweeter centre sits at about (696,411), near the frame centre. The white band under the eave shrinks from 256 px tall at the left edge to about 236 px. The top strip [200,0,1350,40] turns to background (p5 about 165-210 after c1).

out_of_scope.request: Radius or chamfer the waveguide insert's outer edge, or close its gap to the roof, so the joint can catch a highlight instead of drawing an outline round the arch.
out_of_scope.why: The joint reads as a pen line all round the arch: a 1 px dip to 34.8 between 66.7 and 67.5 at (803,300), and 29.8 between 68.3 and 67.3 at (321,400), with no highlight on either lip. A light cannot add a highlight to an edge that has no radius. The insert, its fit and its edge are the product's geometry, which the card fixes.
